entities.name: Pablo Sáinz Villegas
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pablo Sáinz Villegas is a Spanish classical guitarist. He was born in Logroño in La Rioja Province and began his musical studies there before going on to an international career. Among his awards was the 2008 Critical Eye Award in classical music. In 2018, he was signed by the Sony Classical label. His first recording for Sony was Volver with Plácido Domingo, a collection of Iberian and Latin American songs. The production also involved arranger conductor and pianist Nazareno Andorno. Villegas has been based in New York City since 2001.
